evidence.detail: rs/d/h$a is an enum with surviving exact constants REGULAR, OLDSCHOOL and OSRS.

R28 FloorDefinition stores the active rs/d/h$a value and its mode-switching loader selects the corresponding floor-definition source/decoder; R71 FloorOverlayDefinition accepts the same enum and switches its overlay-definition source in lockstep.
Client region/map loading explicitly switches both floor underlay and overlay definitions to OSRS for OSRS data, to OLDSCHOOL for the old-school path, and back to REGULAR for the normal path.

candidates.note: FloorDefinitionMode is the conservative semantic name for this exact floor underlay/overlay definition mode enum; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.

evidence.detail: rs/d/r$a is an enum with surviving exact constants STANDARD, OLDSCHOOL, NEW and OSRS.
R28 ObjectDefinition stores the active rs/d/r$a value, reloads its object-definition data/index pair when that value changes, and dispatches different decode paths according to the selected mode.
Client region/map loading selects OSRS for OSRS map data, OLDSCHOOL for the old-school path, NEW for the designated newer object-definition path, and STANDARD for the normal path.
OSRS cache/map dependency tooling and runtime object loading both inspect the same enum-backed ObjectDefinition mode, tying it specifically to object-definition format/source selection.

candidates.note: ObjectDefinitionMode is the conservative semantic name for this exact object-definition source/decoder mode enum; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
